verdict.rationale: Amplitude's Experiment docs say you can run A/B, multivariate and bandit tests, target segments, and "measure causal lift" so data drives the release decision. That covers the core of running experiments and reading their results. However, goal-metric configuration and statistical-significance reporting are only implied by the lift language, not explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of goal/primary metric setup, explicit statistical significance or confidence reporting on results, independent hands-on corroboration.
